selection_rule: All three predetermined state-0/seed-11 pairs, plus the first cap-10-success/cap-50-failure pair and first reverse pair in the frozen collection order. A pair is ordered by its first episode occurrence; duplicate selections share one review group.

groups.observations: All three methods lift the can by step 60, carry it toward the basket at steps 80-119, and finish with the can in the basket. Logged completion is step 137 for fixed K=10, 141 for cap 10, and 129 for cap 50, using 14, 21, and 8 model calls respectively.
groups.hypothesis: Longer executed chunks were sufficient in this matched setting. The images do not demonstrate that the extra cap-10 updates caused its slightly later completion.

evidence_refs.finding: Can visible beneath the gripper after leaving the tabletop, then moving toward the basket.

groups.observations: Cap 50 moves the bowl toward the plate at steps 55-81 and succeeds at step 81. Fixed K=10 and cap 10 repeatedly reposition nearby and time out at step 280; their plates visibly tilt (fixed: 77-81; cap 10: 90-97). Gripper-command sign changes are not counted as grasp attempts.
groups.hypothesis: More frequent updates did not resolve these two failed trajectories. Continued resampling may interrupt a useful motion sequence, but these videos cannot separate that effect from earlier pose and action differences.
